rules.rules_primary: If the greatest seeding disadvantage overcome by any winner in the full tournament of the 2026 Men's College Basketball Tournament is at least 9, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this market, an upset occurs when a team with a higher numerical seed defeats a team with a lower numerical seed. Upset seed margin is calculated as the difference between the seed numbers of the two teams in a game where the higher numerical-seeded team wins (for example, if a 12-seed defeats a 5-seed, the upset seed margin is 7).

rules.rules_primary: If Tie is the result of the first half of regulation time in the UConn vs Michigan men's college basketball game originally scheduled for Apr 6, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules.rules_secondary: The following market refers to the team that scores the most points during the specified half. Only points scored during the specified half of play count towards this market. If both teams score the same amount of points during the half, all team strikes resolve to No and the Tie strike resolves to Yes. If this game is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled game has finished (within two weeks).
